breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the incorrect instruction to replace distributed self-weight with a single concentrated end load as an exact force. Instead, it correctly uses the continuously varying axial force P(x) = ρ g A (L − x) and integration over the length, matching the ground truth approach.
